column1: #   commit: b8871acd336fa1c84b87cab701f3224b15a7a2ba (repo HEAD at copy time, 2026-09-04)
# Do not edit here; extend upstream and re-copy. Target-specific SKU spellings
# Crstl PO alert — item identifier -> RDZ item alias map
# Partners identify the same physical item in different ways, and some order
# multi-packs that consume several units of a base item. This file maps any
# partner-supplied identifier to the RDZ `Item #` that holds its inventory,
# plus how many base units one ordered unit consumes.
#   code         a partner style/item/part number not already in RDZ form
#   desc         exact, case-insensitive free-form description; last resort
# base_qty — base units consumed per ordered unit. 1 for a single. For an
# Amazon multi-pack it is the pack count: one ordered K-60WIP-AP-GRA-3PK
# consumes 3 units of P-60WIP-AP-GRA. Coverage is ALWAYS computed on the
# base item in base units, because RDZ stocks the base, not the pack.
# Matching runs on the NORMALIZED form of both sides (SKILL.md §4d).
# Every run prints "Unmapped identifiers" naming what it could not resolve.
# Add a row per entry. Do NOT guess — a wrong alias reports coverage against
# the wrong item, which is worse than an honest warn.
# AMAZON VENDORCENTRAL — from amazon_item_mappings.xlsx + the Catalog &
# Forecast template, both supplied 2026-08-31. Amazon POs carry only
# upc_default, so this table is the sole way to reach an RDZ item for them.
# ASINs are recorded in the note for traceability back to the listing.
# Five of these (the dispensers) were independently corroborated by pairs
# harvested from Target/Thrive/Grove POs — zero conflicts.

# 08-31 go-live batch. Do NOT map these; they must not match anything:

# Other partners — pairs harvested 2026-08-31 from Crstl itself: each was
# observed on a real PO from a partner that sends the UPC and the style
# number on the same line (Target, Thrive Market, Grove Collaborative).
# Partner codes not already in RDZ form. The P-60 prefix rule in SKILL.md §4d
